author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Announces selected live platforms with title, category, profile picture, category art and preview imagery, including shared metadata during multistreams.
changelog: 4.1.7: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.7, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: adds separate platform embeds, direct live links, and a creator-controlled OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop start fallback for TikTok. 2.4.2: initial release with stable stream identity, multi-platform coalescing, channel/forum destinations, role mention validation, source-derived links, simulation suppression, and bounded persistent deduplication.

manifest.name: Live Beacon

actionsProvided.name: THSV Addon - Live Beacon - Broadcast Started

installationSteps: Add your Discord webhook under Platforms > Discord webhooks and choose it in Live Beacon settings. A platform can use a different webhook when it posts to a different channel or forum.
Choose Create for me or Use existing posts. Create for me makes and remembers each permanent post on its first genuine live event; existing mode uses copied Discord Channel IDs.
Only when selected platforms need a broadcast-app fallback, import the Live Beacon Streamer.bot package and attach OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs Desktop Streaming Started to Broadcast Started.
Configure platform links and templates, then enable the add-on.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its short history that stops repeat announcements is kept.

healthChecks.description: Confirms verified online events can produce guarded per-platform Discord deliveries.
